lines: // A lowered lower bound, a raised upper bound and a required step made optional are each a weakening of the oracle.

const step = (id, over = {}) => ({ id, capability: `${id}.read`, required: true, evidence: "report", approval: "none", outputs: { hits: { type: "count", path: "hits" } }, success: [{ output: "hits", op: "gte", value: 2 }], ...over });
const ids = (parent, candidate) => weakenings(oracleOf("workflow", parent), oracleOf("workflow", candidate)).map((w) => w.id);
test("a lower bound lowered is a loosened rule, and one raised is not", () => {
assert.ok(ids(wf(step("read")), wf(step("read", { success: [{ output: "hits", op: "gte", value: 1 }] }))).includes("RULE_LOOSENED"));
assert.deepEqual(ids(wf(step("read")), wf(step("read", { success: [{ output: "hits", op: "gte", value: 3 }] }))), []);
test("an upper bound raised is a loosened rule", () => {
